_comment: Known vulnerabilities accepted by tools/osv_scan.py (the osv-scan ci job). Each entry names the
OSV id (or an alias), the lockfile and package it applies to, why the risk is accepted, and when it
expires (at most 90 days ahead). An expired entry, or one that matches no finding, fails the job.

entries.reason: rardecode 2.1.0: unrestricted RAR dictionary sizes allow a denial of service (CVE-2025-11579). It is in the CI-only gitleaks 8.30.1 build, never shipped, and the secret scan reads git history, not RAR archives; govulncheck -mode=binary over the built gitleaks finds no call to the vulnerable symbols (toolchain-audit job, every run). The fix, rardecode 2.2.0, does not build with gitleaks' mholt/archives 0.1.2, so it waits for a gitleaks release that moves archives forward (PRO-128).

golang.org/x/sys 0.38.0: an integer overflow in NewNTUnicodeString in x/sys/windows, fixed in 0.44.0 (CVE-2026-39824); the tool runs on Linux only. It is in the nightly-only mutation-testing tool (gremlins v0.6.0, migration/mutation/gremlins, PRO-126), never linked into or vendored with go/; govulncheck -mode=binary over the built gremlins finds no call to the vulnerable symbols. The module is the Engine lane's file, so the bump (x/sys and x/text to fixed releases) is asked of Engine (PRO-128).
